product_one_liner.value: Fundraise Up is an AI-powered online fundraising and donation platform that helps nonprofit organizations increase donations and recurring giving through higher-converting donor experiences.
product_one_liner.notes: Company homepage and About page describe the product and nonprofit audience.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes performance-based pricing and fees.

named_customers.notes: Both appear as named customer case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists company size 201–500 employees; Tracxn reports 395 employees in September 2026.

hq_location.notes: The company About page states headquarters in Brooklyn, New York; LinkedIn corroborates.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index is marketing/product and fundraising content; available indexed posts do not establish two posts on engineering or how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple product and integration guides and API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job listing includes multiple open roles, but none has an AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title. Head of Data does not meet the specified title criteria.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed product/security information and public trust-center/subprocessor search; found no company statement identifying a provider used by its own product models. Anthropic appearing in a subprocessor search result alone does not establish which model or provider the product uses.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed certifications/standards are taken exactly from the company's security page; GDPR is included because it is among the requested items.

last_funding.notes: The January 2025 announcement describes $70 million of growth capital; reporting and investor-related posts identify it as Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest located funding announcement is January 2025, outside the 18-month period preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive, Education Vertical role is listed.

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced Tap to Donate and Peer-to-Peer Fundraising on July 29, 2026, within the six-month window. Its 2026 changelog also shows ongoing feature updates.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company leadership page lists leadership, but it does not provide start dates, and no verifiable announcement of a C-level or VP-level join or departure within the period was located.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are visibly named on Fundraise Up's integration documentation. Omitted Zapier because it is an integration/automation platform rather than a CRM or sales/marketing system.
